📌 Key points要点

⭐ Must know必须记住
  • r=x2+y2​>0; sinθ=ry​, cosθ=rx​, tanθ=xy​.r=x2+y2​>0；sinθ=ry​, cosθ=rx​, tanθ=xy​。
  • One ratio + quadrant: draw the triangle, find the third side, give x,y their quadrant signs.已知一个比值和象限：画三角形，求第三边，按象限给 x,y 定符号。
  • Angle: reference angle from the positive ratio, then place it in the quadrant.求角：用正的比值求参考角，再放进对应象限。

💡 SOH CAH TOA only works inside a right triangle, so what could sin127∘ possibly mean? Put a point on the terminal arm and the coordinates answer it — signs included.SOH CAH TOA 只在直角三角形里用，那 sin127∘ 又是什么意思？在终边上取一个点，坐标就能回答——连正负号一起。

  1. Take any point P(x,y) on the terminal arm. Its distance from the origin is r=x2+y2​, always positive.在终边上任取一点 P(x,y)，它到原点的距离 r=x2+y2​，永远为正。
  2. sinθ=ry​, cosθ=rx​, tanθ=xy​. The signs of x and y make the ratios positive or negative — that is where CAST comes from.sinθ=ry​，cosθ=rx​，tanθ=xy​。x、y 的符号决定比值的正负——CAST 就是这样来的。
  3. Given one ratio and the quadrant: draw the point, fill in the missing coordinate with x2+y2=r2 (pick its sign from the quadrant), then write the other ratios.已知一个比值和象限：画出点，用 x2+y2=r2 补出缺的坐标（符号由象限决定），再写其他比值。
  4. To find θ: get the reference angle from the POSITIVE ratio (e.g. tan−1​xy​​), then place it in the right quadrant.求 θ：用比值的绝对值求参考角（如 tan−1​xy​​），再放到正确的象限。

🧮 Key formulas关键公式

r=x2+y2​
Distance from the origin到原点的距离
sinθ=ry​,cosθ=rx​,tanθ=xy​
Primary trig ratios of any angle任意角的三个基本三角比
🎯 Test tip考试提示
Sketch the point and a right triangle down to the x-axis every time — the triangle gives the numbers, the quadrant gives the signs. For "find θ" questions, list ALL angles in the stated range, not just the calculator one.每次都画出这个点，并向 x 轴画一个直角三角形——三角形给数值，象限给符号。「求 θ」时，要写出规定范围内的所有角，不只是计算器给的那一个。

🧭 How to get started怎么入手

Ask yourself these five, in order, before writing anything. Every worked example on this page is labelled with them.动笔之前，按顺序问自己这五个问题。本页每道例题的步骤都标了它们。

  1. 🔎 Given已知
    What do you have: a point, or one ratio plus a clue (a quadrant, or the sign of another ratio)? Write the two of x, y, r you know, with signs.已知什么：一个点，还是一个比值加一条线索（象限，或另一个比值的符号）？写出已知的 x、y、r 中的两个，带上符号。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    Which ratios, exact or decimal? And θ in 0∘≤θ<360∘, rounded as asked.要哪些比值，精确值还是小数？以及 0∘≤θ<360∘ 内的 θ，按要求取近似。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    Sketch the axes, put the point in its quadrant, drop a line to the x-axis to make the reference triangle, and label x, y, r.画坐标轴，把点放进它的象限，向 x 轴作垂线得到参考三角形，标出 x、y、r。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Missing piece from x2+y2=r2 (sign from the quadrant, r always positive). Then sin=ry​, cos=rx​, tan=xy​; reference angle from the positive ratio; place it: 180∘−, 180∘+ or 360∘−.用 x2+y2=r2 求缺的那个（符号看象限，r 永远为正）。再写 sin=ry​、cos=rx​、tan=xy​；用正的比值求参考角，再放到象限里：180∘−、180∘+ 或 360∘−。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    CAST: do the signs of your three ratios match the quadrant? Is θ really in that quadrant?CAST：三个比值的符号和象限对得上吗？θ 真的落在那个象限吗？

🧱 Prerequisite check先修检查

4 quick Grade 9–10 questions, about 3 minutes. Miss one and a 5-minute repair card opens right there; fix it, then carry on.4 道九、十年级小题，约 3 分钟。错了就在原地打开 5 分钟补救卡，补好再继续。

1SOH CAH TOA and Pythagoras直角三角形：SOH CAH TOA 与勾股定理
A right triangle has legs 6 and 8. What is the sine of the angle opposite the side of length 6?直角三角形两直角边为 6 和 8。长 6 的边所对角的正弦是多少？

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · SOH CAH TOA and Pythagoras直角三角形：SOH CAH TOA 与勾股定理 (Grade年级 10)
In a RIGHT triangle, from angle θ: sinθ=hypopp​, cosθ=hypadj​, tanθ=adjopp​. The hypotenuse is opposite the right angle; a2+b2=c2. Calculator in DEGREE mode.在直角三角形中，从角 θ 看：sinθ=斜边对边​，cosθ=斜边邻边​，tanθ=邻边对边​。斜边对着直角；a2+b2=c2。计算器设为角度（DEG）模式。
  1. Legs 3 and 4: hypotenuse 9+16​=5; sinθ=53​ for the angle opposite 3.两直角边 3 和 4：斜边 9+16​=5；对着 3 的角 sinθ=53​。
  2. Find an angle: θ=sin−1(0.6)≈36.9∘.求角：θ=sin−1(0.6)≈36.9∘。
Try one:试一道：
A right triangle has hypotenuse 10 and an angle of 30∘. How long is the side opposite the 30∘ angle?直角三角形斜边为 10，一个角是 30∘。30∘ 角的对边多长？

2Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根
Find 92+122​.求 92+122​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Perfect squares and square roots完全平方数与平方根 (Grade年级 8–10)
Know the squares 1,4,9,…,225. ab​=a​b​, so 50​=25​2​=52​. But a+b​=a​+b​: 9+16​=5, not 7. x​ means the non-negative root.记住 1,4,9,…,225 这些平方数。ab​=a​b​，所以 50​=25​2​=52​。但 a+b​=a​+b​：9+16​=5，不是 7。x​ 表示非负的那个根。
  1. 72​: biggest square factor is 36 → 62​.72​：最大的平方因数是 36 → 62​。
  2. x2=49 has TWO answers x=±7, but 49​=7 only.x2=49 有两个解 x=±7，但 49​ 只等于 7。
Try one:试一道：
Which is equal to 48​?哪个等于 48​？

3Negative numbers: add, subtract, multiply负数的加减乘
Simplify −8−6​.化简 −8−6​。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Negative numbers: add, subtract, multiply负数的加减乘 (Grade年级 7–9)
Subtracting a negative is adding: 5−(−3)=5+3=8. Same signs multiply to +, different signs to −. Squaring a negative is positive: (−4)2=16, but −42=−16 (the square happens first).减去负数等于加上它：5−(−3)=5+3=8。同号相乘得正，异号相乘得负。负数的平方是正的：(−4)2=16，但 −42=−16（先算平方）。
  1. −7−(−2): change "minus negative" to "plus": −7+2=−5.−7−(−2)：把「减负」改成「加」：−7+2=−5。
  2. (−3)(−5)=15 (same signs), (−3)(5)=−15 (different signs).(−3)(−5)=15（同号），(−3)(5)=−15（异号）。
  3. Plugging in x=−3 to x2: write brackets first, (−3)2=9.把 x=−3 代入 x2：先加括号，(−3)2=9。
Try one:试一道：
Evaluate b2−4ac when a=2, b=−3, c=−1.当 a=2, b=−3, c=−1 时，求 b2−4ac。

4Reading a graph: points, intercepts, slope读图：点、截距、斜率
The point (−4,3) is in which quadrant?点 (−4,3) 在第几象限？

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Reading a graph: points, intercepts, slope读图：点、截距、斜率 (Grade年级 9–10)
A point is (x,y): across first, then up. x-intercepts are where y=0 (the graph crosses the horizontal axis); the y-intercept is where x=0. Slope =runrise​=x2​−x1​y2​−y1​​.点写作 (x,y)：先横后纵。x 截距是 y=0 的地方（图象穿过横轴处）；y 截距是 x=0 的地方。斜率 =横向变化纵向变化​=x2​−x1​y2​−y1​​。
  1. For y=x2−4: y-intercept at x=0 is −4; x-intercepts solve x2−4=0: x=±2.y=x2−4：令 x=0 得 y 截距 −4；令 y=0 解 x2−4=0 得 x 截距 x=±2。
  2. Above the x-axis means y>0; below means y<0.在 x 轴上方表示 y>0；下方表示 y<0。
Try one:试一道：
Where does y=2x−6 cross the x-axis?y=2x−6 与 x 轴交于哪里？

Topics this builds on:本知识点建立在： Special angles & the unit circle特殊角与单位圆

tanθ=−247​ and cosθ>0. Find sinθ, cosθ, and θ (0∘≤θ<360∘) to the nearest tenth.tanθ=−247​ 且 cosθ>0。求 sinθ、cosθ，以及 θ（0∘≤θ<360∘，精确到 0.1°）。

Example 3例 3L3 Connect会用2 methods种解法
tanθ=−32​ and sinθ<0, with 0∘≤θ<360∘. Find exact values of sinθ and cosθ, and θ to the nearest tenth.tanθ=−32​，sinθ<0，0∘≤θ<360∘。求 sinθ、cosθ 的精确值，以及 θ（精确到 0.1°）。
  1. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    tan<0 means Q II or Q IV. sin<0 means Q III or Q IV. Both true: Q IV.tan<0：第二或第四象限；sin<0：第三或第四象限。同时满足：第四象限。
  2. 🔎 Given已知
    In Q IV, x>0 and y<0. tanθ=xy​=3−2​, so take x=3, y=−2.第四象限 x>0、y<0。tanθ=xy​=3−2​，取 x=3，y=−2。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    r=9+4​=13​.r=9+4​=13​。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    sinθ=13​−2​=−13213​​, cosθ=13​3​=13313​​ (rationalized).sinθ=13​−2​=−13213​​，cosθ=13​3​=13313​​（分母有理化）。
  5. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Reference angle tan−132​≈33.7∘. Q IV: θ=360∘−33.7∘=326.3∘.参考角 tan−132​≈33.7∘。第四象限：θ=360∘−33.7∘=326.3∘。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    tan−1(−32​)≈−33.7∘ — that is a clockwise angle, already in Q IV.tan−1(−32​)≈−33.7∘——这是顺时针的角，本来就在第四象限。
  2. ✅ Check检验
    Add 360∘ to get it into 0∘–360∘: 326.3∘ ✓. Check: sin326.3∘≈−0.555≈−13​2​ ✓.加 360∘ 化到 0∘–360∘：326.3∘ ✓。验算：sin326.3∘≈−0.555≈−13​2​ ✓。
Answer答案
sinθ=−13213​​, cosθ=13313​​, θ≈326.3∘
🧭 What this example trains这道题练什么
🎯 Goal考查目标
Use two sign conditions to find the quadrant, then give exact ratios and the angle.用两个符号条件确定象限，再给出精确比值和角。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Angles in standard position标准位置角Trig ratios of any angle任意角的三角比Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🔗 Connecting ideas知识联系🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
💡 Key idea解题思路
Intersect the two quadrant conditions first; only then choose the point and its signs.先把两个象限条件取交集，再取点并定符号。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Quadrant first, then the point, then reference angle.先定象限，再取点，最后用参考角。
  • Calculator tan−1 gives a negative angle; add 360∘ and check with sin.先用计算器得到负角，加 360∘ 后用 sin 验算。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Someone made each of these. Tap the line where it first goes wrong.每道题都有人这样做过。点出第一处出错的那一行。

1Wrong sign on the missing coordinate缺的坐标符号取错
sinθ=135​ and θ is in quadrant II. Find cosθ.sinθ=135​，θ 在第二象限。求 cosθ。

🧠 A square root from a calculator is always positive, so the quadrant never got a say. In Q II the point is left of the y-axis.计算器开方总给正数，象限根本没被考虑进去。第二象限的点在 y 轴左边。

🔧 x=±12; Q II needs x<0, so x=−12 and cosθ=−1312​.x=±12；第二象限要 x<0，所以 x=−12，cosθ=−1312​。

✔ cosθ=−1312​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 C

2Stopping at the calculator angle停在计算器给的角上
P(8,−15) is on the terminal arm. Find θ, 0∘≤θ<360∘, to the nearest tenth.P(8,−15) 在终边上。求 θ（0∘≤θ<360∘，精确到 0.1°）。

🧠 The calculator answers in its own range, not the range the question set. Its output is a clue, not the answer.计算器按自己的范围给答案，不按题目要求的范围。它给的只是线索，不是答案。

🔧 Q IV, reference angle tan−1815​≈61.9∘: θ=360∘−61.9∘=298.1∘.第四象限，参考角 tan−1815​≈61.9∘：θ=360∘−61.9∘=298.1∘。

✔ θ≈298.1∘

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 A

3Mixing up x and y in the ratios比值里 x 和 y 用反了
P(−9,40) is on the terminal arm. Find sinθ.P(−9,40) 在终边上。求 sinθ。

🧠 SOH CAH TOA was learned with "opposite" and "adjacent", and the switch to x and y did not stick. Sine goes with the height y.SOH CAH TOA 是用「对边」「邻边」学的，换成 x、y 后没记牢。正弦对应的是高度 y。

🔧 sinθ=ry​=4140​ (and cosθ=rx​=−419​).sinθ=ry​=4140​（而 cosθ=rx​=−419​）。

✔ sinθ=4140​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 A, Check-up测评 Q1 D

4Reading the sign clue as the wrong quadrant把符号线索读成了错的象限
sinθ=−0.6 and tanθ>0. Find θ, 0∘≤θ<360∘, to the nearest tenth.sinθ=−0.6 且 tanθ>0。求 θ（0∘≤θ<360∘，精确到 0.1°）。

🧠 Only one clue was used. sin negative allows Q III or Q IV; the second clue, tan positive, is what picks between them.只用了一条线索。sin 为负可能是第三或第四象限；第二条线索 tan 为正才能二选一。

🔧 sin <0 and tan >0: Q III. θ=180∘+36.9∘=216.9∘.sin <0 且 tan >0：第三象限。θ=180∘+36.9∘=216.9∘。

✔ θ≈216.9∘

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 B, Check-up测评 Q2 D

5Giving r a negative sign给 r 加了负号
P(−5,−12) is on the terminal arm. Find sinθ.P(−5,−12) 在终边上。求 sinθ。

🧠 It treats r like a coordinate. r is a distance from the origin, and a distance is never negative.把 r 当成了坐标。r 是到原点的距离，距离不会是负的。

🔧 r=25+144​=13, so sinθ=−1312​ (Q III, sin negative ✓).r=25+144​=13，所以 sinθ=−1312​（第三象限，sin 为负 ✓）。

✔ sinθ=−1312​

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 3

⚠️ Quick list速查

  • Giving r a negative sign. r is a distance, always positive; only x and y carry signs.给 r 加负号。r 是距离，永远为正；只有 x、y 带符号。
  • Typing tan−1(−32​) and writing −33.7∘ as the final answer when the question wants 0∘≤θ<360∘. Convert with the reference angle.题目要求 0∘≤θ<360∘，却直接写计算器给的 −33.7∘。要用参考角换算。
  • Choosing the wrong sign for the missing coordinate. Decide the quadrant first, then the sign of x or y.缺的坐标符号选错。先确定象限，再定 x 或 y 的符号。

💡 Why it works为什么成立

Trigonometric Ratios For Any Angle - Quadrant by Quadrant
Fred Kong · 7 min · ↗
Same 3-4-5 triangle in all four quadrants, so you can watch only the signs change; that is the whole idea of this topic in seven minutes.同一个 3-4-5 三角形在四个象限里各出现一次，你只会看到符号在变——七分钟讲完这个知识点的核心。
⏩ From 0:00: shows why opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse become y, x and r once the angle sits on the coordinate plane, then walks through the points (3,4), (−3,4), (−3,−4) and (3,−4), one quadrant each, ending with which ratios stay positive.从 0:00 开始：说明角放进坐标系后，对边、邻边、斜边为什么变成 y、x、r；再依次看 (3,4)、(−3,4)、(−3,−4)、(3,−4) 四个点，每个象限一个，最后总结哪些比值为正。

🪜 Step by step一步一步

Master Trigonometric Ratios Using CAST Rule| STEP-BY-STEP GUIDE – Pre-Calculus 11
Mathsupport · 8 min · ↗
Made for BC Pre-calculus 11; it builds CAST from the coordinates instead of asking you to memorise it, and the 30° / 150° example sets up the next topic, trig equations.为 BC Pre-calculus 11 制作；CAST 是从坐标推出来的，不用死记；30° 与 150° 的例子也为下一节三角方程打好基础。
⏩ From 0:20: the signs of x and y in each quadrant and the ratios they give; 3:07 shows sin30∘=sin150∘=0.5 (one ratio, two angles); 6:18 assembles the CAST diagram.从 0:20 开始：每个象限里 x、y 的符号以及由此得到的比值；3:07 演示 sin30∘=sin150∘=0.5（一个比值，两个角）；6:18 拼出 CAST 图。

  2. Reference cos−10.6≈53.1∘; θ=360∘−53.1∘=306.9∘.参考角 cos−10.6≈53.1∘；θ=360∘−53.1∘=306.9∘。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Use a ratio and a sign condition on another ratio to pin down the quadrant, the other ratios and the angle.由一个比值和另一个比值的符号确定象限，再求其他比值和角。

💡 Key idea解题思路
cos>0 and tan<0 force Q IV, so y is negative.cos>0 且 tan<0，只能是第四象限，所以 y<0。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Draw the 3-4-5 triangle in Q IV and read the ratios.在第四象限画 3-4-5 三角形读比值。
  • Calculator angle 53.1∘ is the reference angle, not the answer.计算器给出的 53.1∘ 只是参考角，不是答案。
How did it go?做得怎样？
8L4 Solve会想🌍 Modelling建模🔗 Connecting ideas知识联系🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
A wind turbine hub is 60 m above level ground. Looking at the turbine face-on, take the hub as the origin with the blades turning counterclockwise. At one moment the tip of a blade is 24 m to the left of the hub and 32 m above it. (a) How long is the blade? (b) What is the angle θ of the blade in standard position at that moment, to the nearest tenth? (c) The blade turns another 90∘ counterclockwise. How high above the ground is the tip then?面对风力发电机，以轮毂为原点，叶片逆时针转动。轮毂离平地 60 m。某一时刻叶尖在轮毂左侧 24 m、上方 32 m。(a) 叶片多长？(b) 此刻叶片在标准位置的角 θ 是多少（精确到 0.1°）？(c) 叶片再逆时针转 90∘，叶尖离地多高？
The tip is the point (−24,32); r is the blade length.叶尖就是点 (−24,32)；r 就是叶片长度。
(a) 40 m; (b) θ≈126.9∘; (c) 36 m above the ground(a) 40 m；(b) θ≈126.9∘；(c) 离地 36 m
  1. r=242+322​=40 m.r=242+322​=40 m。
  2. Reference angle tan−12432​≈53.1∘; Q II gives θ=180∘−53.1∘=126.9∘.参考角 tan−12432​≈53.1∘；第二象限：θ=180∘−53.1∘=126.9∘。
  3. After the quarter turn the angle is 216.9∘, so the tip is 40sin216.9∘=−24 m relative to the hub.转 90∘ 后角为 216.9∘，叶尖相对轮毂的高度是 40sin216.9∘=−24 m。
  4. Height above ground =60−24=36 m. Check: turning (x,y) by 90∘ gives (−y,x)=(−32,−24) ✓.离地高度 =60−24=36 m。验证：点 (x,y) 转 90∘ 得 (−y,x)=(−32,−24) ✓。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Model a rotating blade with a point, an angle past 90∘ and a quarter turn.用点、超过 90∘ 的角和四分之一转来描述旋转的叶片。

💡 Key idea解题思路
The tip is a point on the terminal arm; its height above the hub is the y-coordinate, i.e. rsinθ.叶尖就是终边上的点；它比轮毂高多少就是 y 坐标，即 rsinθ。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Add 90∘ to θ and use 40sin(θ+90∘).把 θ 加上 90∘，用 40sin(θ+90∘) 计算。
  • Rotate the point itself: (x,y)→(−y,x), no angle needed.直接转动点：(x,y)→(−y,x)，不用求角。
